name: magic-translator
description: Extension Thunderbird de traduction d'e-mails via Google Translate.
author: MTF Karukera

scripts.lint: eslint background.js mt-text.js mt-providers.js translator-injected.js setup/setup.js options/options.js compose/compose.js
scripts.lint:webext: bash build.sh >/dev/null && (node ~/.cache/thunderbird-webext-linter/verify.js --warnings-as-errors "$(readlink -f dist/magic-translator.xpi)"; status=$?; rm -rf dist/xpi-review-*; exit $status)
